scripts.dev:ai: powershell -Command "cd services/ai; if (Test-Path .venv/Scripts/python.exe) { & .venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 } else { python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 }"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.setup:ai: powershell -Command "cd services/ai; python -m venv .venv; & .venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt"
